title: 10. Exercises: Concurrency Design Patterns
summary: Create circuit breaker that adjusts thresholds based on error rates.
objectives: Solve the Concurrency Design Patterns exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
### Exercise 1: Priority Queue Producer-Consumer

Implement producer-consumer with priority queue.

### Exercise 2: Rate-Limited Worker Pool

Create worker pool with rate limiting (max N tasks/second).

### Exercise 3: Multi-Stage Pipeline

Build pipeline with configurable stages and error handling.

### Exercise 4: Distributed Fan-Out

Implement fan-out across multiple machines (simulated).

### Exercise 5: Adaptive Circuit Breaker

Create circuit breaker that adjusts thresholds based on error rates.

### Exercise 6: Retry with Circuit Breaker

Combine retry and circuit breaker patterns.

### Exercise 7: Dynamic Bulkhead

Create bulkhead that adjusts limits based on response times.

### Exercise 8: Event Sourcing Pattern

Implement event sourcing with async event handlers.

### Exercise 9: Saga Pattern

Implement distributed transaction using Saga pattern.

### Exercise 10: CQRS Pattern

Implement Command Query Responsibility Segregation with async.
